title: 4-Tier Ladder Towel Bar 30-Inch Wall Mount Solid Brass | Carolina Collection | Allied Brass
description:
Upgrade towel storage with a 30-inch wall mount ladder towel bar crafted from solid brass with four horizontal bars for organized drying and display. From the Carolina Collection, this traditional bathroom hardware piece brings refined, timeless styling while saving space with a vertical ladder shape.

Highlights:
- 4-tier ladder design provides plenty of room for towels at varying heights
- Wall-mounted installation helps conserve floor space in smaller baths
- Crafted of solid brass with a durable designer finish
- Concealed screw mounting for a clean, classic look
- Coordinate with matching Carolina Collection classic bath accessories

Specs:
- Category: Towel bar (vertical ladder)
- Center-to-center: 30 in
- Overall size: 35 in H x 30 in L; projection 3.3 in
- Bar diameter: 0.75 in
- Weight capacity: 20 lb
- Mounting: Wall mount; assembly required: No
- Included: Ladder towel bar and all installation hardware (screws: #8 x 1 1/4")
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
- Finish options: Available in a wide variety of designer finishes, including statement colors.
